subject.recordFor: Which baby is this record for?
subject.current: Who this record is for, and who can see it
subject.adult: This is your own health or mood record, kept separate from baby records.
subject.shareRecord: Show this one record to the family {{name}}
subject.shareNotice: Choosing a baby does not share a record. Both this choice and baby-sharing permission in this family's settings are required.
subject.sharingOff: Baby sharing is off for this family. Review your family sharing settings if you want to share.
subject.permissionChanged: Sharing settings changed. Clear this record's sharing checkbox, review the latest preferences and select it again if appropriate.
subject.unassignedNotice: You can keep an unassigned private record. Past records are never assigned to a baby or shared with family automatically.
subject.all: All my care subjects and my own health
subject.manage: Register or review a baby's nickname
subject.notice: You can register one personal baby and one baby per family. A nickname is enough; a legal name or birth date is not required. The adult who recorded care remains separately identified.
subject.familyNotice: Active family members can see a family nickname. Family managers create or rename it. Registration does not move or share past records.
subject.personalNotice: This nickname is private to your account and is not automatically linked to a family baby.
subject.createAndSelect: Register and select for my next record
subject.loadError: Could not check the care subjects. Reload the latest list.
subject.managerOnly: Ask a family manager to register or rename the family's baby.
subject.conflict: A subject already exists or changed on another screen. Review the list.
subject.saveError: Could not confirm the result. Reload the list and check whether it was saved.
subject.sheetFor: Baby records to include in the consultation sheet
subject.sheetNotice: Use only your own records for the selected baby. Unassigned includes only unassigned records. Your own health and free-text notes remain separate choices.

period.title: Recent care records
period.notice: Records with a confirmed end time are included when they overlap this period. Displayed durations are not totals clipped to the period. Unrecorded time is unknown.
period.empty: No records to display for this period and subject. Unrecorded care remains unknown.
period.keepEnd: Keep the end time I confirmed
period.deriveDuration: With an end time, the saved duration is calculated from the reviewed start and end in whole minutes, rounded down.
period.startedToday: Records starting today (all my care subjects)
period.totalsNotice: These totals group records by their start day, unlike the timeline's overlapping periods. Durations include only recorded time.

work.title: Continue where you left off
work.notice: Opening this screen does not save, contact anyone or restore drafts automatically. Choose what you want to review.
work.quickPending: Check the last quick record's save status
work.quickRecovery: Review an earlier quick-record retry draft
work.recordPending: A record's save result still needs checking
work.recordUnsent: Review a record that has not been sent yet
work.duplicateReview: Review nearby family records before saving
work.timerPending: Check the timer record's save result
work.timerReview: Review and save a stopped timer
work.contactPlan: Review the contact plan you chose
work.waiting: Review a consultation awaiting a reply
work.contactDraft: Review a consultation you are preparing
work.loadError: Could not check the latest plans or drafts. Previously retrieved information may still be shown.

duplicate.title: Review a family record from around this time?
duplicate.notice: Your family has a shared record for the same baby and type within five minutes. It may be a different event. Records are never merged or deleted automatically.
duplicate.unavailable: Could not check nearby family records. You can save this record or return to your input.
duplicate.continue: Save this content as a separate record

journey.response: What I heard from the contact (my notes)
journey.nextSteps: What I plan to do next
journey.notice: Only you can see these notes. They are not an AI answer or verified professional instructions. Finishing or pausing removes the planned contact time.

review.notice: Saved review results, owners and dates remain available to staff after signing in again. Resume pending or due items. Published content still requires a separate preview and publication.
review.internal: Internal staff handoff (not shown to families)
review.internalNotice: Save an owner, deferral reason and next review date. Do not include family names or health information. Unsaved input stays only on this screen.
review.reason: Review notes or deferral reason (required to defer)
review.defer: Save the reason and review later
review.saveNewFirst: Save the institution draft before deferring a newly added contact.
review.saveAllDraft: Save the reviewed edits and the entire current institution draft. This does not publish anything.
review.saveEdited: Save edited draft and handoff; continue
review.saveChecked: Save draft and unchanged confirmation; continue
review.confirmDates: Confirming unchanged applies the checked date and next review date above to the publication draft too. The whole draft and handoff are saved; publication remains separate.
review.finished: This session's reviews and deferrals are saved. Other staff can continue from the saved items.
review.unsaved: There is unsaved input in the internal handoff.
review.savedTasks: Saved internal handoffs and review results
review.stale: The publication draft changed after this review. Review its current content again.

errors.dates: Check the dates. The checked date must be no later than today, and the next review date must be after today.
errors.reason: Enter a short reason for deferring.
errors.save: Could not confirm saving. Your input remains. Review the institution's latest state before saving again.

onboarding.support: Start by preparing to talk to someone

record.title: Start with one care record
record.hint: Check who the record is for, then choose the care activity. The receipt and recent records let you review and correct it. To practice without a real save, open the recording example further down Home.

family.title: Review family membership and sharing
family.hint: If you have an invitation, check the family you are joining. Joining does not enable record sharing. Choose the care subject and what you want to share separately.

support.title: Start with what you want help with
support.hint: Choose a suitable contact and prepare what to say. Calling or opening a booking link does not mark the contact as reached. Use only the steps you need.
